title: Method parameters — did:webvh and did:scid:vh key-role identities
description: The schemas `methodParameters` is validated against for `vta/dids/create` and `vta/dids/update` when the identity's method is `webvh` or `scid:vh` (webvh.md §8). A member not defined here is refused with `vta/dids:methodParameterUnsupported`.

serverId.description: Hosting service to publish through. Absent means the caller publishes the log itself at `url` (`selfPublish`).

url.description: Where the log will be served, when there is no hosting service.

portable.description: Whether the log may move host and keep its identity. Fixed at creation.

presentAs.description: The form the VTA presents the new identity in (VTI-KEY-165). Fixed at creation. Absent applies the VTA's configuration.

scidAlsoKnownAs.description: Whether the first entry lists the did:scid DID URL in `alsoKnownAs` (VTI-KEY-166). Fixed at creation; MUST be true where `presentAs` is `scid:vh`.

ttlSeconds.description: The `ttl` parameter: the input to the cache horizon (webvh.md §5).

watchers.description: An empty array removes every watcher.
